analysis.summaryJa: このページは、now と then で基準時を現在・過去・未来へ動かし、ago・before・by now・just now・for now で出来事と基準時の距離を表す。ago は現在から過去を測り、before は文脈上の過去時点より前を示せる。by now は現在までの完了予想、just now はほんの少し前、for now は当面を表す。
grammarPoints: now は現在時点、then は文脈上の別の時点を指す
ago は現在を基準に過去までの距離を表す
過去の基準時より前は before を使う
by now は現在までには完了・到達しているという予想を表す
just now は通常「たった今、ほんの少し前」を表す
for now は「今のところ、当面」を表す
then は出来事の順序で「その後」を示すこともある
visualEvidence: タイムライン上で NOW の現在点と THEN の移動可能な基準点が色分けされている
ago の矢印が現在点から左へ伸び、before の矢印が過去の基準点からさらに左へ伸びている
by now の期限線、just now の現在直前の短い区間、for now の一時的な帯が描かれている
手順カードの間に then が置かれ、出来事の順序を前へ進めている
commonTraps: 過去の基準時からさらに前を ago で表す
two years before now のように不自然に基準を重ねる
by now を単なる「今」と解釈する
just now を必ず現在進行の「まさに今」と考える
for now を forever と同じ恒久状態と解釈する
then の指す時点を文脈から特定しない

questions.prompt: The customer called ten minutes ------- to confirm the delivery address.

choices.B: before
choices.C: then
choices.D: by now

questions.translationJa: 顧客は10分前に配送先住所を確認するため電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在から10分さかのぼるので ago を使います。

questions.prompt: The branch moved to this building in 2022; -------, it operated near the station.

choices.B: before then
choices.C: by now
choices.D: for now

questions.translationJa: 支店は2022年にこの建物へ移転し、それ以前は駅の近くで営業していました。
questions.explanationJa: 2022年という過去の基準時より前を before then で表します。

questions.prompt: The repair team left the site -------, so they should reach the depot soon.

choices.B: by then
choices.C: just now
choices.D: three hours before

questions.translationJa: 修理チームはたった今現場を出たので、まもなく拠点へ着くはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 現在のほんの少し前の出来事には just now が合います。

questions.prompt: We will use the temporary meeting room ------- while the main room is renovated.

choices.B: by now
choices.C: before then
choices.D: for now

questions.translationJa: 主会議室の改装中は、当面臨時会議室を使います。
questions.explanationJa: 一時的な現状を表す for now が適切です。

questions.prompt: The courier departed at 8:00 A.M. and should have reached the airport -------.

choices.B: just now
choices.C: ago
choices.D: for then

questions.translationJa: 配達員は午前8時に出発したので、今ごろは空港へ到着しているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までには完了しているという予想を by now で示します。

questions.prompt: First save the revised file, and ------- upload it to the shared folder.

choices.B: then
choices.C: before
choices.D: by now

questions.translationJa: まず改訂ファイルを保存し、その後共有フォルダーへアップロードしてください。
questions.explanationJa: 手順の次の動作を示す then が適切です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ortega joined the company five years ------- and became a manager last year.

choices.B: by then
choices.C: ago
choices.D: for now

questions.translationJa: オルテガさんは5年前に入社し、昨年管理職になりました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在を基準に5年前なので ago を使います。

questions.prompt: When we inspected the warehouse in March, the leak had been reported two weeks -------.

choices.B: now
choices.C: for then
choices.D: before

questions.translationJa: 3月に倉庫を点検した時点で、漏水はその2週間前に報告されていました。
questions.explanationJa: 基準は過去の3月なので、さらに前は before で表します。

questions.prompt: The supplier promised an answer by Friday. It is Monday -------, and no reply has arrived.

choices.B: ago
choices.C: then before
choices.D: for now then

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は金曜日までに回答すると約束しました。今は月曜日ですが、返答はありません。
questions.explanationJa: 発話時点の現在を明示する now が自然です。

questions.prompt: The software license expires next month; -------, all users will need new credentials.

choices.B: then
choices.C: just now
choices.D: before now

questions.translationJa: ソフトウェアのライセンスは来月切れ、その時には全利用者が新しい認証情報を必要とします。
questions.explanationJa: 来月という未来時点を受ける then が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence locating an event relative to the present.

choices.A: The new receptionist started three weeks before now ago.
choices.B: The new receptionist ago started three weeks.
choices.C: The new receptionist started three weeks ago.
choices.D: The new receptionist started ago three weeks before.

questions.translationJa: 新しい受付担当者は3週間前に勤務を始めました。
questions.explanationJa: 期間の後ろに ago を置き、現在から過去を測ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence locating one past event before another past event.

choices.A: By the time the auditor arrived, the clerk had left an hour ago.
choices.B: By the time the auditor arrived, the clerk has left an hour before.
choices.C: By the time the auditor arrived, the clerk had before left an hour ago.
choices.D: By the time the auditor arrived, the clerk had left an hour before.

questions.translationJa: 監査担当者が到着した時には、担当者はその1時間前に退社していました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の到着時点より前なので before を使い、過去完了と組み合わせます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence predicting completion by the present time.

choices.A: The delivery should have arrived by now.
choices.B: The delivery should arrive ago now.
choices.C: The delivery should have by now arrived ago.
choices.D: The delivery by now should has arrived.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は今ごろ到着しているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: should have arrived by now で現在までの完了予想を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a very recent phone call.

choices.A: Mr. Khan calls just now about the contract yesterday.
choices.B: Mr. Khan called just now about the contract.
choices.C: Mr. Khan called for now about the contract.
choices.D: Mr. Khan just now has call about the contract.

questions.translationJa: カーンさんはたった今、契約について電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: ほんの少し前の完了した出来事には過去形と just now が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a temporary arrangement.

choices.A: By now, visitors temporarily used the east entrance tomorrow.
choices.B: Ago, visitors should use the east entrance.
choices.C: For now, visitors should use the east entrance.
choices.D: For now visitors, should used the east entrance.

questions.translationJa: 当面、来訪者は東入口を使用してください。
questions.explanationJa: 文頭の For now は一時的な指示を表し、コンマで区切ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing the next step in a procedure.

choices.A: Check the account number then, submit payment request the.
choices.B: Check then the account number, submit the payment request.
choices.C: Check the account number, ago submit the payment request.
choices.D: Check the account number, then submit the payment request.

questions.translationJa: 口座番号を確認し、その後支払申請を提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: then は二つの手順の順序を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence referring back to a past period.

choices.A: The office had no video-conference equipment then.
choices.B: The office then had no video-conference equipment ago.
choices.C: The office has no video-conference equipment then yesterday.
choices.D: Then the office, have no video-conference equipment.

questions.translationJa: その当時、事務所にはビデオ会議設備がありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: then が文脈上の過去時点を指し、過去形 had と結び付きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a report expected to be finished already.

choices.A: The analyst should completed the report by now.
choices.B: The analyst should have completed the report by now.
choices.C: The analyst should have complete the report just now ago.
choices.D: The analyst by now should has completed the report.

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者は今ごろ報告書を完成しているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: should have + 過去分詞 + by now が完了予想の正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an earlier change relative to a 2025 review.

choices.A: During the 2025 review, we learned that the policy had changed the year ago.
choices.B: During the 2025 review, we learn that the policy changed the year before now.
choices.C: During the 2025 review, we learned that the policy had changed the year before.
choices.D: During the 2025 review, the policy had change one year ago then.

questions.translationJa: 2025年の見直し時に、方針がその前年に変わっていたと分かりました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の2025年を基準にするため the year before を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting the present with a later future time.

choices.A: The fee is low ago, but it may be higher now before.
choices.B: The fee low is now, but may it higher be then.
choices.C: The fee is low by now, but it was higher next year ago.
choices.D: The fee is low now, but it may be higher then.

questions.translationJa: 料金は今は安いですが、その時には高くなるかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: now は現在、then は前に示された未来時点を指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The package left just now.”

choices.A: The package departed only a moment ago.
choices.B: The package will leave much later.
choices.C: The package has been gone for several years.
choices.D: The package is temporarily staying here.

questions.translationJa: 荷物はたった今出発しました。
questions.explanationJa: just now は only a moment ago とほぼ同じです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We will keep the current procedure for now.”

choices.A: The procedure will remain unchanged forever.
choices.B: We will continue using the procedure temporarily.
choices.C: The procedure ended a long time ago.
choices.D: The procedure must have changed by now.

questions.translationJa: 当面、現在の手順を維持します。
questions.explanationJa: for now は恒久ではなく一時的な継続を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The technician should be here by now.”

choices.A: The technician left only a moment ago.
choices.B: The technician will not be expected for several years.
choices.C: The technician was expected to have arrived before the present time.
choices.D: The technician was here before a different past event.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は今ごろここにいるはずです。
questions.explanationJa: by now は現在までの到達が予想されていることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The company opened this branch six years ago.”

choices.A: The branch will open six years from now.
choices.B: The branch closed at a past reference point.
choices.C: The company operated for only six days.
choices.D: The branch began operating six years before the present.

questions.translationJa: 会社は6年前にこの支店を開設しました。
questions.explanationJa: ago は現在を基準に過去への距離を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The machine failed in May; before then, it had worked normally.”

choices.A: The machine operated normally until a time prior to its May failure.
choices.B: The machine began working normally after the May failure.
choices.C: The machine is expected to work by now.
choices.D: The machine failed again only a moment ago.

questions.translationJa: 機械は5月に故障し、それ以前は正常に動いていました。
questions.explanationJa: before then は5月の故障という過去時点より前を指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Complete the form, then send it to accounting.”

choices.A: Send the form before completing it.
choices.B: After completing the form, send it to accounting.
choices.C: Keep the form temporarily and never send it.
choices.D: Accounting completed the form years ago.

questions.translationJa: 用紙を記入し、その後経理へ送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 順序の then は after that と同じ関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager spoke to the supplier two days before.”

choices.A: The manager will speak two days from now.
choices.B: The manager spoke exactly two days before the present in every context.
choices.C: The manager’s conversation occurred two days earlier than the past reference time.
choices.D: The supplier spoke only a moment ago.

questions.translationJa: 管理者はその基準時の2日前に仕入先と話しました。
questions.explanationJa: before は文脈上の過去基準より earlier であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Now the office is open, but it was closed then.”

choices.A: The office is closed both now and at every other time.
choices.B: The office will open only after several years.
choices.C: The office opened a moment ago and has no past status.
choices.D: The office’s present status differs from its status at the referenced past time.

questions.translationJa: 今は事務所が開いていますが、その当時は閉まっていました。
questions.explanationJa: now と then が異なる基準時の状態を対比しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “By now, all participants should have received the link.”

choices.A: It is reasonable to expect that everyone has received the link already.
choices.B: The link will first be created next year.
choices.C: No participant was expected to receive it.
choices.D: Everyone received the link before a specific past meeting only.

questions.translationJa: 今ごろ参加者全員がリンクを受け取っているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: by now と should have は現在までの完了期待を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I spoke with her just now, not yesterday.”

choices.B: The conversation happened a moment ago rather than the previous day.
choices.C: The conversation is planned for a future day.
choices.D: The speaker has not talked with her recently.

questions.translationJa: 昨日ではなく、たった今彼女と話しました。
questions.explanationJa: just now は直前の短い時間を指します。

questions.prompt: The train left at 9:00, and it is already 11:30. It should have reached the terminal -------.

choices.B: for now
choices.C: by now
choices.D: two hours ago then

questions.translationJa: 列車は9時に出発し、すでに11時30分です。今ごろ終点に着いているはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 経過時間から現在までの到着を予想するので by now が適切です。

questions.prompt: The main entrance is being repaired this week. -------, employees should enter through the loading area.

choices.B: Before then
choices.C: By now forever
choices.D: For now

questions.translationJa: 正面入口は今週修理中です。当面、従業員は搬入口から入ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 修理期間中だけの一時的指示なので For now を使います。

questions.prompt: A caller disconnected only seconds before the receptionist checked the line. The receptionist said, “She was here -------.”

choices.B: by now
choices.C: for now
choices.D: the year before

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者が回線を確認する数秒前に電話が切れました。「彼女はたった今までいました」と言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 数秒前という直前の出来事は just now で表します。

questions.prompt: The company opened the regional office in 2018. That was eight years ------- from the present reference year of 2026.

choices.B: ago
choices.C: by now
choices.D: for then

questions.translationJa: 会社は2018年に地域事務所を開設しました。2026年の現在から8年前です。
questions.explanationJa: 現在基準年2026から過去を測るため ago が適切です。

questions.prompt: At the 2024 audit, staff discovered that the backup rule had been removed one month -------.

choices.B: now
choices.C: before
choices.D: for now

questions.translationJa: 2024年の監査時、バックアップ規則がその1か月前に削除されていたことが分かりました。
questions.explanationJa: 2024年という過去基準からさらに前なので before を使います。

questions.prompt: First verify the customer’s identity. -------, open the account record.

choices.B: By now
choices.C: For before
choices.D: Then

questions.translationJa: まず顧客の本人確認をしてください。その後、口座記録を開いてください。
questions.explanationJa: 二段階の手順の次を示す Then が正解です。

questions.prompt: The warehouse was much smaller in 2010. Back -------, online orders represented only 5 percent of sales.

choices.B: ago
choices.C: now
choices.D: by now

questions.translationJa: 2010年には倉庫はずっと小規模でした。当時、オンライン注文は売上の5パーセントだけでした。
questions.explanationJa: Back then は前に示された過去時点を指す定型表現です。

questions.prompt: The vendor promised to email the certificate yesterday morning. It is late afternoon -------, but nothing has arrived.

choices.B: now
choices.C: before then
choices.D: for now only then

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は昨日朝に証明書をメールすると約束しました。今は午後遅くですが、何も届いていません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在時点を過去の約束と対比する now が適切です。

questions.prompt: The project began in January 2025. Six months -------, the team moved into the testing phase.

choices.B: by now
choices.C: later
choices.D: before now

questions.translationJa: プロジェクトは2025年1月に始まり、6か月後に試験段階へ移りました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去の開始点から未来側へ進むので later が自然で、ago ではありません。

questions.prompt: The client meeting is scheduled for next Thursday. -------, the final price will be known.

choices.B: Just now
choices.C: For now before
choices.D: By then

questions.translationJa: 顧客会議は次の木曜日に予定されています。その時までには最終価格が判明します。
questions.explanationJa: 未来の木曜日を期限とするため By then を使います。
